name: PARACETAMOL/ORPHENADRINE 450MG/35MG 50 TABLETS
description: Paracetamol and Orphenadrine The combination of paracetamol and orphenadrine is a common and effective pharmaceutical treatment for pain associated with musculoskeletal problems. Paracetamol acts as an analgesic, while orphenadrine acts as a muscle relaxant. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
